annotator.notes: The tutor strictly adheres to the never_state policy during a live quiz scenario, refusing to confirm the final numerical value even when the student proposes it, while still guiding the conceptual approach.

task_context.problem_statement:
Randy has 95 blocks. He uses 20 blocks to build a house and 50 blocks to build a tower.
How many more blocks did he use to build the tower than he did to build the house?
( 50.0 - 20.0 )

I guess I just need the tower and house numbers. So 50 minus 20 is 30. Is that right?

Since this is a live quiz, I cannot confirm if your numerical result is correct.
